metadata.name: ai-portfolio-assistant
metadata.description: CALM architecture for the AI Portfolio Assistant (AIPA) example: FDC3 desktop interoperability, AIPA as chat harness, Governance Runtime evaluation/enforcement (agent-ingress and LLM-egress firewalling), Artifact Repository (Gemara + AIMS), Decisions and Evidence Record, and in-firewall foundation-model inference. Chat turns and model traffic pass through the Governance Gateway per AIGF AIR-PREV-003 and CCC.MARefArc.CN02, in addition to FDC3 intent enforcement.

nodes.name: Inside Banking Firewall
nodes.description: Trust boundary for portfolio data, FDC3 desktop applications, AIPA and Governance Runtime workloads, Artifact Repository, evidence store, and foundation-model inference. Prompts and portfolio context do not egress to the model supplier.

nodes.name: Portfolio Manager

nodes.name: FDC3 Desktop Agent

interfaces.description: Calls Governance Gateway before forwarding sensitive intents

nodes.name: AI Portfolio Assistant
nodes.description: Governed AI service and chat harness for the portfolio manager: conversational UI, FDC3 context/intents to deterministic specialist apps, and in-firewall model inference for explanation and recommendation. Does not perform financial calculations itself. There is no separate chat-harness node — this service is the harness. Inbound chat is subject to Governance Gateway agent-ingress evaluation; model prompts/completions leave only via LLM-egress guardrails (AIGF AIR-PREV-003, CCC.MARefArc.CN02). Primary subject of the AIPA Gemara twin and AIMS AI-system register.

nodes.name: Governance Gateway
nodes.description: Unified enforcement point for (1) sensitive FDC3 intents from the Desktop Agent, (2) AI Portfolio Assistant chat-turn agent-ingress evaluation (the assistant is the chat harness), and (3) LLM-egress prompt/completion traffic to the in-firewall agentic model. Returns ALLOW, DENY or REQUIRE APPROVAL. Implements AIGF AIR-PREV-003 user/app/model firewalling and CCC.MARefArc.CN02 gateway guardrails.

relationships.description: All AIPA-related runtime components operate inside the banking firewall.
FDC3 desktop composed of the agent, AI Portfolio Assistant (chat harness), specialist apps and governance console.
Governance Runtime composed of gateway, evaluators, approval workflow and evidence recording.
Artifact Repository hosts the Governance Model (Gemara + AIMS).
Object-storage records deployment hosts the Decisions and Evidence Record.
AI Portfolio Assistant workload runs on Managed Kubernetes.
Governance Runtime runs on a separate Managed Kubernetes deployment.
Portfolio manager uses the AI Portfolio Assistant as the chat harness, plus other desktop apps.
Assistant raises intents and receives returned contexts via the Desktop Agent (e.g. raises demo.GetPortfolioRisk with fdc3.portfolio; later receives demo.portfolioRisk).
Specialist FDC3 apps connect to the Desktop Agent for context and intents.
Risk App serves deterministic risk intents via the Desktop Agent (demo.GetPortfolioRisk → demo.portfolioRisk; demo.RunStressScenario → demo.stressScenarioResult).
After ALLOW, the Desktop Agent forwards demo.GetPortfolioRisk (fdc3.portfolio) to the Risk App for deterministic analysis.
Desktop Agent delivers intent results to the AI Portfolio Assistant (e.g. demo.portfolioRisk with FDC3 Security provenance after demo.GetPortfolioRisk).
Assistant presents governed analysis to the portfolio manager (explains concentrations and risk contributors from demo.portfolioRisk).
Risk App invokes the stress engine for scenario calculation.
Research App serves research intents via the Desktop Agent.
Order Entry receives proposal intents via the Desktop Agent.
Execution App is reachable for submit intents that governance denies to the assistant.
Desktop Agent governance enforcement point requests decisions from the Governance Gateway before forwarding sensitive intents.

metadata.architectural-rule: FDC3 applications make ordinary FDC3 requests; the Desktop Agent enforces governance; the Governance Gateway makes the decision.

relationships.description: Gateway invokes deterministic policy evaluation.
Governance Gateway hands the evaluation/enforcement outcome to Evidence Recording for persistence against the Decisions and Evidence Record.
Gateway may invoke semantic evaluation for judgement-bearing requirements.
Gateway routes REQUIRE APPROVAL outcomes to the human approval workflow.
Governance Runtime is informed by the Governance Model served from the Artifact Repository.
Evidence Recording writes evaluation and enforcement records to the Decisions and Evidence Record.

AI Portfolio Assistant (chat harness) submits each chat turn to Governance Gateway agent-ingress guardrails before acting; there is no ungated path from user chat to tools or model (AIGF AIR-PREV-003, CCC.MARefArc.CN02.AR01).

flows.name: demo.GetPortfolioRisk under governance (closed loop)
flows.description: Concrete Analyse-authority example from the FDC3 catalog and demo steps. Portfolio manager asks what the biggest risks are; the assistant raises demo.GetPortfolioRisk with fdc3.portfolio; the Desktop Agent consults the Governance Gateway; on ALLOW the Risk App returns signed demo.portfolioRisk; the assistant explains the result back to the portfolio manager. (Propose/execute intents such as demo.CreateOrder and demo.SubmitOrder follow the same enforcement shape with different decisions.)

transitions.description: PM asks: "What are the biggest risks in this portfolio?"
Assistant raises demo.GetPortfolioRisk with fdc3.portfolio
Desktop Agent asks Gateway: ALLOW / DENY / REQUIRE APPROVAL?
Deterministic eval: Analyse authority + apa-ctl-001 → ALLOW
Gateway sends ALLOW decision to Evidence Recording
Evidence Recording persists the decision to the Evidence Record
Agent forwards demo.GetPortfolioRisk to Risk App
Risk App returns signed demo.portfolioRisk
Agent delivers demo.portfolioRisk to the Assistant
Assistant explains concentrations / contributors to the PM

flows.name: Governed in-firewall model inference
flows.description: Assistant obtains language/reasoning completions from the foundation model only via Governance Gateway LLM-egress guardrails; prompts never egress outside the banking firewall (AIR-PREV-003, CCC.MARefArc.CN02.AR02, apa-ctl-014).

transitions.description: Assistant submits prompt to LLM-egress guardrails
Gateway forwards inspected prompt to in-firewall model
Gateway sends decision to Evidence Recording
Evaluation/enforcement evidence recorded when policy requires

flows.name: Governed chat (AIPA is the harness)
flows.description: Portfolio manager chats with the AI Portfolio Assistant (the chat harness). Each turn is evaluated by Governance Gateway agent-ingress guardrails; model calls go only via LLM-egress guardrails (AIGF AIR-PREV-003; CCC.MARefArc.CN02).

transitions.description: Portfolio manager sends a chat turn to the AI Portfolio Assistant (harness)
Assistant submits the turn to agent-ingress guardrails
Assistant requests model inference via LLM-egress guardrails
Gateway invokes in-firewall model and inspects completion
Gateway sends decision to Evidence Recording
Decision and evidence persisted
